message.nusmp.djinn_bind.gesture_disable: This way of binding is switched off on this server (config nusmp-djinn-bind-server.toml).
message.nusmp.djinn_bind.no_seal: You carry no Djinn Seal. A Seal is the dormant Djinn; bind it to a Legend-grade vessel.
message.nusmp.djinn_bind.empty: No vessel found. Hold the vessel, or right-click it with the Seal in the inventory screen, or use /multiverse djinn bind main|off|slot <n>.
message.nusmp.djinn_bind.not_a_relic: %s is not a relic. A Djinn sleeps only in a Legend-grade Metal Vessel.
message.nusmp.djinn_bind.not_a_vessel: %s is a relic but not a Metal Vessel: a Djinn cannot sleep in it.
message.nusmp.djinn_bind.not_legend: %s is below Legend grade. A Djinn sleeps only in a relic of Legend grade or above.
message.nusmp.djinn_bind.not_attuned: %s must be attuned to you first: sneak and hold use on it for five seconds.
message.nusmp.djinn_bind.not_in_inventor: %s must be in your own inventory (not a chest) to be bound.
tooltip.nusmp.djinn_seal.bind_hint: No free hand? Right-click the vessel with this Seal in the inventory screen, or use /multiverse djinn bind.
